leadText: Kenta Kamakari (Japanese: 鎌苅健太 Kamakari Kenta) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Kenta Kamakari (Japanese: 鎌苅健太 Kamakari Kenta) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Kamakari was born on February 17, 1984, in , . He started work on the with , where he voiced DJ Leo. Kamakari is currently affiliated with talent group Yzpapa.

In addition to being a voice actor, Kamakari is also an actor and singer. He was the leader and vocalist of the band Cocoa Otoko that was active from April 2010 until its final performance on March 31 2012.
